name: Auto Parts Connection
old_description: Whether you're coming in for a new motor, bumper, or new lights, we promise that you will be completely satisfied with your replacement parts. We provide warranties on most of our products to ensure your peace of mind.
about:
Auto Parts Connection operates from a retail location at 3853 E. Craig Road, Suite 6, in North Las Vegas, Nevada. The business does not publish a founding year, and ownership details are not disclosed; the primary contact listed is Ruben. The shop began as a local source for replacement auto parts, aiming to provide a straightforward purchasing experience for area drivers.

The company sells replacement components such as motors, bumpers, and lighting assemblies. It does not manufacture parts but sources them from established brands and backs most items with a warranty. The facility functions as a walk-in retail shop with stated hours of Monday through Friday 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. and weekends 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are provided.

The shop serves individual vehicle owners in the Las Vegas metropolitan area who need replacement parts for a variety of makes and models. Customer reviews describe transactions ranging from air filter consultations to instrument panel rebuilds, indicating a base of retail consumers rather than wholesale or OEM accounts.

The company emphasizes a stress-free buying experience, citing a staff with over 20 years of combined auto experience and a commitment to sourcing only from reputable brands. These points are presented as the core reasons customers choose the shop over larger chain alternatives.
